verdict.rationale: v0 is a chat-driven agent, and its own docs describe safety nets for iterating: isolated branches, preview deployments built from working branches, duplicating a branch into a new chat, CI checks, and automatic error fixing. That lets a founder try changes without touching production. There is no direct evidence that follow-up prompts preserve existing working functionality, and no community corroboration of regression-free iteration. Missing for 10: explicit docs on how follow-up prompts edit without regressions (e.g. scoped diffs or version restore), and hands-on reports confirming iterative refinement stays stable.

support.subject: As a founder, I can refine my app through follow-up prompts without breaking what already works

citations.quote: work on isolated branches, preview changes, run CI, and publish through pull requests
Preview deployments are built from working branches.
The Duplicate Branch dialog creates a new chat and branch containing the current branch's commits.
Automatically fix errors in your code with intelligent diagnostics.
v0 reads the relevant logs, diagnoses the failure, and applies a fix.
